header:
# Town of Morristown municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 15; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Morristown (official website), staff and boards directory: lists the five selectboard members as Donald McDowell (Chair), Richard Craig, George Cormier, Leah Hollenberger, and Rose Belanger

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Donald McDowell (Chair), Rose Belanger, and George Cormier among Morristown's selectboard members

Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the certified results of the March 4, 2025 annual town meeting re-elected Richard Craig (836 votes, three-year term) and Donald McDowell (1,120 votes, two-year term)
Town of Morristown (official website), staff and boards directory: lists Sara Haskins as Town Clerk
Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the Elected Town Officers page lists Sara Haskins as Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Sara Haskins as Morristown's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Sara Haskins as Morristown's town clerk
Town of Morristown (official website), staff and boards directory: lists Sara Haskins as Town Treasurer
Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the Elected Town Officers page lists Sara Haskins as Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Sara Haskins as Morristown's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Sara Haskins as Morristown's town treasurer

Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the Appointed Officers page lists 'Delinquent Tax Collector -- Sara Haskins, 3 Year Term' among the officers appointed by the Selectboard; the membership is recorded as appointed

Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the certified results of the March 4, 2025 annual town meeting elected Shapleigh Smith, Jr. Moderator with 1,318 votes for a one-year term expiring in 2026; the March 2026 outcome is not published in any source located, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Morristown (official website), staff and boards directory: lists the Board of Listers as Grant Wieler (Chair) and Kevin Petrochko, with the third seat vacant

Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the certified March 4, 2025 results mark write-in candidate Grant Wieler the winner of both the three-year lister seat (38 write-ins) and the two-year remainder seat (40); he holds one seat. The Elected Town Officers page marks Kevin Petrochko's seat '(Appointed 5/5/25)'; his membership is recorded as appointed. Brian Yeaton, listed in the report, has departed and the third seat is vacant

Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the Elected Town Officers page lists three Trustees of Public Funds on staggered terms: Sara Haskins (expiring 2026), Mitzi Fleming (2027), and Julia Compagna (2028); the certified March 4, 2025 results mark write-in candidate Julia Compagna the winner with 121 votes. Haskins's seat expired in 2026 and its outcome is unpublished, so it is left unfilled
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Morristown justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024

Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the report's justice of the peace page lists Jane Foster and Aimee Towne, who are not in the Secretary of State's listing, and omits the listing's Charles Burnham and Roland Billings; the certified listing governs -- see the election note

jp_election.name: Town of Morristown Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Morristown justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Darcie Abbene, Judy Bickford, Donald Blake, Jr, Julia Compagna, Richard Craig, Leah Hollenberger, Urban Martin, Monte Mason, Yvette Mason, Shelley Nolan, Siri Rooney, Shapleigh Smith, Jr, Edward Wilson, Charles Burnham, and Roland Billings. The Town of Morristown's 2025 Annual Town Report lists Jane Foster and Aimee Towne as justices of the peace instead of Burnham and Billings; the certified listing governs the election record, and Foster and Towne (possible mid-term appointees) are not recorded as holders. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
Town of Morristown, 2025 Annual Town Report: the report's justice of the peace page carries the Foster/Towne divergence described in the election note
